summary: Organic Go/SQLite tenant-catalog work package: xmin/xmax snapshot isolation, logical JSONL WAL, CDC-from-WAL, epoch-fenced replica apply, FK-ordered apply, hold-qty/frozen constraints, and checkpoint redo. Shared WAL/MVCC vocabulary with golden and local storage tasks is normal domain overlap; instruction-envelope cadence with event-time-session-window-processor is a house-style wrapper, not a renamed clone. Clone/reskin risk is low.

evidence.observation: Operator repair of /app/catalog via catalogctl: visibility, commit-after-WAL, constraints, indexes, WAL-decoded CDC, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-safe apply, checkpoint redo, inspect/empty-check must not recover. Not a Python recover_engine or C++ LSM crash-repro prompt.

Binding catalog plane: heap xmin/xmax, wal.jsonl BEGIN/mutation/COMMIT|ABORT, replica_slot confirmed_lsn+epoch, decode skips uncommitted txns, apply rejects stale epoch without advancing the slot, FK rank tenant/sku/offer/hold.

Distinct product tree: catalogctl, SQLite heap+replica, JSONL WAL/CDC, indexes.json, bounce.log/oncall.md, seed of 12000 committed versions plus s-crash-pending. Starter CDC heap-scans SKUs; recover installs uncommitted WAL and bumps epoch; inspect calls recover.

Verifier topology is CLI mutation-safety, frozen/hold-qty/unique/FK rejects, decode skip-abort, apply monotonic+stale-epoch+FK order, recover drops crash insert without epoch bump, indexes/health/warehouse. Not segment durable_count gaps or LSM flush/compaction races.

Solution shape installs eight Go modules (snapshot, constraints, indexes, cdc, replica, recover, inspect, cli) then rebuilds catalogctl and runs recover/decode/inspect — a multi-layer catalog realignment, not a single-function WAL prefix fix.
Pinned golden neighbors are wal-recovery-ordering and mvcc-lsm-compaction. Catalog/logical-CDC is not in the 25-task calibration set.

Golden wal-recovery-ordering is a Python in-memory KV engine: make_engine/recover_engine, segment durable_count, contiguous LSN prefix, deep-copy isolation. No catalog tables, logical CDC JSONL, replica slot, or constraint/index plane.
Golden mvcc-lsm-compaction is a reduced C++ RocksDB-like LSM: crash_report.txt, SnapshotContextBuilder/FlushBuilder, regression_test.cc. Visibility/compaction, not logical CDC decode/apply.

Nearest local Databases/WAL/MVCC neighbor is a C++20+Rust embedded KV: binary wal.log, hex keys, prefix scans, first-committer-wins, checksums. Same subcategory tags, different language, disk layout, and failure topology.

Nearest local wording neighbor: quiet-sample + bounce + don't-move-language + notes/oncall.md + warehouse-untouched envelope. Work package is Python event-time sessions/watermarks, not Go catalog CDC/replica apply.
Edition 2 nearest replication motif is S3 inventory/replica_state.json cutover repair, not an OLTP catalog WAL/CDC plane.

Public PostgreSQL logical decoding/slots (xmin, confirmed_flush_lsn) are domain provenance, not a copied benchmark instruction or verifier suite. No catalogctl/s-crash-pending public task clone found.

do_not_change: Do not flatten this into wal-recovery-ordering (Python segment LSN prefix) or mvcc-lsm-compaction (C++ LSM flush/compaction).
Do not replace WAL-decoded CDC, epoch fencing, inspect-must-not-recover, or hold-qty/frozen constraints with a heap-dump or KV-engine reskin.
Do not rewrite catalog-contract.md or the /app/catalog tree merely to differentiate prose from event-time-session-window-processor.
